prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1254; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Pasadena, Texas, I observed two vehicles at rest in the eastbound lanes with visible front-end and driver-side damage. Driver 1 stated that they were traveling straight through the intersection on a green signal when Driver 2, operating a vehicle in the opposing direction, began a left turn across their path. Driver 2 stated that they believed the oncoming lane was clear and did not see Driver 1's vehicle until the impact occurred. A passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was also present and reported no injuries. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was evaluated at the scene by emergency medical personnel before declining transport. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Both vehicles were driven from the scene under their own power after exchange of insurance information. Citations were issued to Driver 2 for failure to yield the right-of-way during a left turn. Witness statements were requested but not obtained at the time of this report.
